name: Clio Manage
hint: An application’s key and secret from the Clio developer portal, and a refresh token; outside the US use your region’s host (eu, ca or au.app.clio.com).

pick.name: list_matters
pick.says: Lists matters. Clio returns only id and etag unless fields names more, e.g. id,display_number,description,status,client{name}.

pick.name: get_matter
pick.says: Returns one matter. Clio returns only id and etag unless fields names more.

pick.name: list_contacts
pick.says: Lists contacts: the people and companies linked to matters. Clio returns only id and etag unless fields names more, e.g. id,name,type,primary_email_address.

pick.name: get_contact
pick.says: Returns one contact. Clio returns only id and etag unless fields names more.

pick.name: list_activities
pick.says: Lists time entries and expenses, for one matter or all. Clio returns only id and etag unless fields names more, e.g. id,type,date,quantity,total,note.

pick.name: list_documents
pick.says: Lists documents’ metadata. Clio returns only id and etag unless fields names more, e.g. id,name,created_at,matter{display_number}.

pick.name: list_tasks
pick.says: Lists tasks. Clio returns only id and etag unless fields names more, e.g. id,name,due_at,status,assignee{name}.

pick.name: list_calendar_entries
pick.says: Lists calendar entries. Clio returns only id and etag unless fields names more, e.g. id,summary,start_at,end_at.

pick.name: list_notes
pick.says: Lists notes on a matter or a contact; type is Matter or Contact. Clio returns only id and etag unless fields names more, e.g. id,subject,detail,date.

pick.name: list_communications
pick.says: Lists logged emails and phone calls. Clio returns only id and etag unless fields names more, e.g. id,subject,body,type,date.

pick.name: who_am_i
pick.says: Returns the user this sign-in acts as. Clio returns only id and etag unless fields names more.

pick.name: create_activity
pick.says: Creates a time or expense entry. Body: {"data": {"type": "TimeEntry", "date", "quantity" (seconds), "note", "matter": {"id"}}}.

pick.name: create_note
pick.says: Adds a note to a matter or a contact. Body: {"data": {"type": "Matter", "subject", "detail", "matter": {"id"}}}.
